morgan: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — recurring KV cache eviction pattern. We need concrete runbook edits (triage steps + commands), clear remediation owners, and an escalation path. Can we assign and set timelines?
incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-cache-evictions — summary + raw traces uploaded. :spiral_notepad: 
priya: I'll take runbook owner for triage steps. @ash can you add the exact commands to check cache / evictions? I can own escalation path edits.
ash: Yup, will add commands and quick checks. Drafted snippet below — can we sanity-check?
ash: ```
# triage checklist (KV cache eviction)
1) Check service health: kubectl get pods -n inference
2) Check logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 200 | grep -i eviction
3) Inspect mem + kv entries: curl -s http://rt-gateway.internal/metrics | grep kv_cache
4) If eviction spike confirmed: scale down batch_size and restart gateway
   kubectl patch cm rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) If not resolved in 10m => escalate to on-call + runtime leads
```
dan: I'll own the runbook doc updates (doc repo: docs/runbooks/kv-eviction.md). Plan to push PR by next Tuesday (2026-03-31).
priya: Thanks @dan. For escalation path please add exact paging rules: page @oncall if >10m, page @runtime-leads if >30m, and open INC ticket. Also include who to cc for Dedicated customers.
ash: Added brief note to the snippet — will include commands to check GPU util and KV cache metrics. Also adding how to pull the KV dump: `curl -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv` (auth required).
morgan: Can we make action items with owners + ticket IDs? I'll create the follow-up ticket and link here.
priya: Assigned action items: 1) runbook edit (dan) - INC-7832, due 2026-03-31; 2) runtime mitigation commands (ash) - INC-7833, due 2026-03-28; 3) add escalation pages and notify matrix (priya) - INC-7834, due 2026-03-25.
dan: ACK. I'll open the PR and tag @priya + @ash for review.
ash: I'll put commands and a quick test play in a runnable snippet and link it in the PR. Also adding a short regression test that runs locally against staging.
morgan: Nice. One more ask — include an explicit check for prefix/KV cache warmup after restart and a smoke test command: `curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz` and sample prompt load.
priya: Good call. Add that to step 6 in the runbook.
dan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1942 — requesting reviewers. ETA for merge: 2026-03-31 EOD.
morgan: Great. I'll track progress in the postmortem follow-up doc and close loop when INC tickets are resolved. Thanks all :thumbsup:
